text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 7, 2025) for 2657 Midland Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order, November 7, 2025, for 2657 Midland Avenue, Folder No. 24 175238 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to March 31, 2026, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City of Toronto.
